basics.name: Parag Gupta
basics.label: DevOps Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer
basics.summary: Building resilient infrastructure and automation — from Kubernetes clusters to AI-augmented observability tooling.

work.name: Adobe
highlights: Built Lens, a Google ADK-based multi-agent assistant that replaces manual Cortex metrics, Splunk log, and MongoDB slow-query/cluster investigation with a single chat interface, using automatic query routing and cross-agent collaboration for AI-driven root cause analysis.
Rolled out zero-code distributed tracing across a Java microservices platform on Kubernetes, and authored the onboarding runbook adopted org-wide as the standard integration pattern.
Led tech stack consolidation across environments, achieving $376K in annual cloud savings.
Developed modular Terraform components that automated multi-environment provisioning, cutting setup time from days to hours.

work.name: Media.net
highlights: Designed and deployed an on-premises Kubernetes cluster as a secure, multi-tenant CaaS platform, enabling teams to onboard quickly.
Modernized infrastructure monitoring and implemented a service mesh to enable secure service discovery and simplify application deployment workflows.

work.name: Tokopedia
highlights: Designed a secure hybrid cloud network (GCP + Alibaba) with Vault-based secrets management, granular access controls, and full-stack logging.
Reduced GCP expenses by 30-40% through workload rightsizing, storage optimization, and VM lifecycle automation.

work.name: Paytm
highlights: Built and operated a 4,000-core OpenStack cluster for the payments QA environment, and deployed a 50TB Elasticsearch cluster to manage high-throughput user data.
Automated infrastructure provisioning and config management using Salt and Ansible, reducing deployment errors by 85%.

work.name: TO THE NEW
highlights: Designed and containerized application architecture for GRAILS and Angular apps, implementing CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and orchestrating deployments using Kubernetes.
Built the highly-available Kubernetes cluster later documented in a published blog post, plus automated backups, DR pipelines, and centralized EFK logging.

projects.name: AIOps Root Cause Analysis (Patent Pending)
projects.description: AI-powered system that fuses metrics, logs, and traces into unified structures for intelligent root cause analysis with continuous learning capabilities.

projects.name: Kubernetes HA Cluster
projects.description: 3-master-node highly-available Kubernetes cluster on CentOS: etcd clustering, Flannel overlay networking, and leader-election for the control plane. Documented in a published blog post.

projects.name: Infrastructure as Code
projects.description: Published, public Terraform module that declaratively manages MongoDB collection indexes from a YAML file - filling a real gap left by the official Atlas provider - with unit tests, a live-database integration test, and CI on every push.

projects.name: Distributed Tracing Platform Rollout
projects.description: Built the reference implementation and onboarding runbook for zero-code distributed tracing across a Java microservices platform, adopted org-wide as the standard integration pattern.

projects.name: Cortex VM Analyzer
projects.description: AI-based root cause analysis that compares an unhealthy VM's metrics -- down to the process level -- against a healthy peer to isolate a resource bottleneck, memory leak, or infra issue before app-level debugging.

projects.name: Lens: Multi-Agent Monitoring Assistant
projects.description: Single natural-language interface replacing manual metrics/logs/database investigation across separate tools: coordinator-based routing and autonomous cross-agent collaboration, built on Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) and not locked to one LLM provider.

projects.name: Cloud Cost Optimization
projects.description: Reserved-capacity planning for DynamoDB, traffic-aware rightsizing for Aerospike, and a unified multi-cloud cost dashboard -- three initiatives covered in a full write-up.
